result:
Small order-utility module for a shop backend: `calcTotal` sums price×qty, `applyDiscount` applies SAVE10/SAVE20 percentage codes, `averageItemPrice` divides total by item count, `formatOrder` renders line items plus a discounted total.

Bugs:
- `calcTotal` (line 5): loop uses `i <= items.length`, reading one past the end — `items[i].price` throws a TypeError on every non-empty array, and returns `NaN`-free 0 only for empty input by crashing first. Should be `i < items.length`.
- `averageItemPrice` (line 20): returns `NaN` for an empty array (0/0) — no guard.
- `formatOrder` (line 26): if a fix ever makes `calcTotal` propagate `NaN`/`undefined` values (e.g. missing `price`), `total.toFixed(2)` would throw; minor, but worth validating item fields.

The off-by-one in `calcTotal` is the critical one — every function here depends on it, so the whole module crashes on any real order.
